:::{#def-almost-everywhere}
#### Almost everywhere

Let $(S, \salg, \mu)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
A statement about the elements of $S$ holds
**$\mu$-almost everywhere**
(written **$\mu$-a.e.**,
or **almost everywhere** when $\mu$ is clear from context)
if the set of elements for which it fails
is a [subset](sets-functions.qmd#def-subset) of a set of [measure zero](#def-measure-zero).

:::
